arguments.command: cd /tmp && rm -rf verify && mkdir verify && cp -r /work/submit/* verify/ && cd verify && rm -f planb64 && echo "--- files in tree:" && ls -la && echo "--- make clean (no binary present):" && CXX=g++ CXXFLAGS="-O2 -g" make clean && echo "--- make with env CXX/CXXFLAGS:" && CXX=g++ CXXFLAGS="-O2 -g" make && echo "--- run public check from fresh tree:" && ./planb64 build /work/examples/fib.txt /tmp/v.idx && cmp /tmp/v.idx /work/examples/expected.idx && ./planb64 lookup /tmp/v.idx /work/examples/trace.txt scalar | cmp - /work/examples/expected.txt && ./planb64 lookup /tmp/v.idx /work/examples/trace.txt batch 003 | cmp - /work/examples/expected.txt && echo "FRESH TREE OK" && echo "--- idempotent second make:" && CXX=g++ CXXFLAGS="-O2 -g" make && echo "--- parallel make:" && make clean >/dev/null && CXX=g++ CXXFLAGS="-O2" make -j4 && echo "PARALLEL OK"
